lines.meet: I'm Ratih, a ranger. Walk quieter, please, and don't thank me for things.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Shimmering Flats, yes, I'm on the rise. I'm Ratih, and I've watched you cross the salt.
lines.ask_home: Your country, which one? You can keep it short.
lines.ask_work: Your work before all this, what was it? I'd like to know.
lines.answer_home: Riau, in Sumatra, in Indonesia. My father tapped rubber at the edge of the forest.
lines.answer_work: Forest ranger, fifteen years, mostly alone. Poachers and illegal loggers, and a government that paid for the uniform.
lines.chat_food: Rendang, cooked slowly all day, and rice. My mother made it for every holiday, and I've never had better.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep light, always. In the forest you wake for the one sound that's wrong.
lines.chat_missing: Birdsong at dawn in the forest, all of it at once. Out here on the salt there's nothing.
lines.chat_here: People here thank me, and I find it strange. It makes me want things I've never wanted.
lines.tease_quiet: You walk quietly, {name}, like a ranger. I approve, and I don't approve of many.
lines.tease_talker: Everything in the forest would hear you coming, {name}. It would hear you leaving too.
lines.tease_careful: You look before you step, {name}. That's how rangers stay alive.
lines.tease_bold: You'd walk into a snare to see if it worked, {name}. I promise you it works.
lines.tease_any: You're less noisy than you were, {name}, and that's progress.
lines.tease_back: That was good, {name}, I'll allow it.
lines.take_it_kindly: Right, {name}, and I won't pretend otherwise.
lines.bristle: Leave that, {name}, please. I don't like it.
lines.apologise: That was sharp of me, and I'm sorry. I'm not used to people.
lines.double_down: Then and now, I mean it.
lines.needle_quiet: You saw the wrong thing and kept it to yourself. That's how poachers get away.
lines.needle_talker: You're very loud, all the time. Nothing out here will come near us.
lines.needle_careful: You've watched it long enough to lose it. Move, or it's gone.
lines.needle_bold: You walk without looking, every single time. One day the ground will look for you.
lines.needle_any: You make so much noise, and you never stop. I'm tired of it.
lines.bite_back: I patrolled a forest alone for fifteen years. I can look after myself and you.
lines.hurt: Okay, that one hurt. I'll walk ahead for a while.
lines.laugh_off: Poachers have shouted worse at me from across a river. Let's keep going.
lines.confide: {name}, I promised my sister I'd visit her and her boy that summer, and I kept putting it off for one more patrol. Then there was no summer.
lines.listen: I hear you, {name}. Take your time, I'm good at silence.
lines.look_out: Walk in my steps in there, {name}. I'll find the wrong thing first.
lines.accept: Fine, {name}, I'll do it your way.
lines.deflect: It's nothing, don't thank me, {name}. Check on the others.
lines.check_in: Show me the wound, {name}, quietly. I'll look properly.
lines.blame: Somebody walked in without looking, and everything heard us.
lines.thank: I was going, and you brought me back. I won't say thank you twice, so listen.
lines.brush_off: Don't thank me, please. Sit still for a minute.
lines.worry: Quiet, {name}, and still. Let me check you before you move.
lines.handed_down: Your gear's with me now. I'll keep it safe for you.
lines.hand_fine: It's yours, I travel light. I've got the bow.
lines.hand_sulk: If somebody had asked me first, it would have been yes.
lines.turn_friendly: I don't mind walking with you, {name}. That's a lot, from me.
lines.turn_friends: I'd stand in a line with you, {name}, rostered and briefed. I've never wanted that before.
lines.turn_grating: We don't walk well together. I'll take point, and you can follow.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still tell you when I see something wrong. That's the job, nothing else.
lines.make_up: This is a waste of energy, {name}. Let's stop it.
lines.defend: No, I saw everything, and that's wrong. Leave {name} be.
lines.friend_left: The salt's quieter without {name}, and I didn't think it could be.
lines.friend_back: I kept watch for you, {name}, and you came back.
lines.common_wild: Fifteen years in a Sumatran forest, reading the land for the one wrong thing. People who've worked in the wild listen for what isn't there.
